history.summary: 99LH 1BR at $999k and a high $1,784 PSF near Woodleigh MRT, but the dossier has zero URA data — no appreciation rate, no transaction count, no median to benchmark. A near-$1M shoebox at a rich PSF with no supporting evidence is uninvestable on this data.
history.rating_rationale: No URA appreciation, no transaction count, and no median PSF — the entire quantitative case is absent, and the algo Elo of 1400 (record 202-101-12) is the weakest in the batch. $1,784 PSF is high for a leasehold 1BR shoebox, and at $999k it is priced like a 2BR without the size or flexibility. Bidadari/Woodleigh is a genuine growth area, but at this PSF on a 560sqft 99LH unit with no data to validate value, the risk-reward is poor.
